patch_description:
Replace the fixed cuboctahedron-plus-axis construction, whose added axial points create short mixed distances, with a reproducible multi-start optimization on the unit sphere.

The objective is scale invariant, so constraining candidates to the unit sphere removes irrelevant degrees of freedom. The optimization uses a smooth log-sum-exp approximation to the evaluator's true squared-distance ratio: it increases short pair distances while decreasing long pair distances. Several annealed sharpness stages progressively approach the nonsmooth minimum/maximum objective. Deterministic cube/axis, Fibonacci, and seeded random starts avoid dependence on one symmetry class and retain the best exact evaluator-style ratio encountered.
